lines: 十万大山，凤凰书院。
寒风怒号，雪花纷纷。
数十丈高的凤凰台，是书院学子大比，决斗之地。
三丈高的玄铁柱上，满是斑斑锈迹。
柱上雕刻着一条神龙，是为盘龙柱，已在此伫立了千年。
今日，盘龙柱更是血迹斑斑，甚至有一抹鲜血溅红了神龙的双眼。
漫天风雪呜咽，一个不到十岁的少年，被一条寒铁所铸的铁链拴在上面。
一道冷漠的声音在风雪中回响。
“学子王贤大逆不道，丧心病狂！残害书院学子！毒害执法长老之子！”
“执法长老有令，废其修为！于凤凰台上行刑！”
执法长老，以刑罚之名，斩了王贤九百九十九剑，每一剑都避开了王贤的心脉。
他要王贤在寒风中流干最后一滴血，最后死在千剑之下......
从昨日的辰时，到现在，已过了一天一夜。
盘龙柱上的王贤，一身精血从伤口中渗出，只剩下那颗不死之心，依旧在缓缓跳动。
挣扎着，用不屈的目光望天。
呢喃道：“司马珏......你竟然害我......”
一枝铁箭刺破漫天风雪，不知从哪里飞出，直上青天，往数十丈的凤凰台飞来......
一道声音在风中冷冷响起：“去死！”
一道铿锵声在寒风中响起，就在铁箭欲要刺入王贤心脏的刹那。
王贤拼命挪动了一下，一枝穿过风雪的神箭，射在铁链之上！
铁链发出一声悲鸣，骤然断开！
“可恶！”
“嗖！”又有一枝神箭刺破风雪，往凤凰台上飞来！
就在这一刹那，天空中突然响起一声轰鸣！
跟着是一道闪电直下，轰在凤凰台上！
一道金光刺破风雪，如天穹之上有一只巨手拔起盘龙柱......
就在一阵轰鸣声中，盘龙柱被寸寸从青石中拔起。
就在无数隐于风雪背后，震惊不已的眼神中！
盘龙柱凌空而起，如龙神腾空，直往九天之上而去！
还没等那一枝神箭飞上凤凰台，盘龙柱携着垂死少年，消失在凤凰台上......
一时间，风雪中有无数身影骤然掠出，往凤凰台上而去......
content_en:
Shiwandashan, Phoenix Academy.
The cold wind howled and snowflakes fell.
The Phoenix Tower, which is dozens of feet high, is the place where academy students compete and duel.
The three-foot-tall black iron pillar was covered with rust stains.
A divine dragon is carved on the pillar, which is called Panlong Pillar. It has stood here for thousands of years.
Today, the Panlong Pillar was even more stained with blood, and there was even a splash of blood that splashed the dragon's eyes red.
The sky was full of wind and snow whimpering, and a boy less than ten years old was tied to it by an iron chain made of cold iron.
A cold voice echoed in the wind and snow.
"Student Wang Xian is rebellious and insane! He brutalized the academy students! He poisoned the son of the law enforcement elder!"
"The law enforcement elder has ordered that his cultivation should be abolished! He will be executed on the Phoenix Platform!"
The law enforcement elder, in the name of punishment, beheaded Wang Xian nine hundred and ninety-nine times, each sword avoiding Wang Xian's heart.
He wanted Wang Xian to bleed the last drop of blood in the cold wind, and finally die under a thousand swords...
A day and a night have passed since yesterday's chen hour.
Wang Xian was on the Panlong Pillar, with blood oozing out from his wounds, leaving only his immortal heart, which was still beating slowly.
Struggling, looking at the sky with unyielding eyes.
He murmured: "Sima Jue... you actually harmed me..."
"Whoosh!"
An iron arrow pierced the wind and snow in the sky, flew out from nowhere, went straight into the sky, and flew towards the Phoenix Tower which was dozens of feet tall...
A voice sounded coldly in the wind: "Go to hell!"
"Ding!"
A clang sounded in the cold wind, just as the iron arrow was about to pierce Wang Xian's heart.
Wang Xian moved desperately, and a divine arrow passed through the snow and hit the iron chain!
The chain let out a mournful cry and suddenly broke!
"Damn it!"
"Whoosh!" Another divine arrow pierced through the wind and snow and flew towards the Phoenix Stage!
"Buzz!"
"Rumble..."
At this moment, a roar suddenly sounded in the sky!
Then a bolt of lightning came down and hit the Phoenix Stage!
A ray of golden light pierced the wind and snow, like a giant hand pulling up a coiled dragon pillar in the sky...
Amidst a roar, the Panlong Pillar was pulled up from the bluestone inch by inch.
Just in the eyes of countless people hiding behind the wind and snow, looking shocked!
The Panlong Pillar rises into the sky, like a dragon god soaring into the sky, heading straight to the nine heavens!
Before the divine arrow could fly to the Phoenix Platform, Panlongzhu took the dying boy and disappeared from the Phoenix Platform...
"Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!"
For a moment, countless figures suddenly emerged from the wind and snow and headed towards the Phoenix Platform...
